rows.en: So I can support big brother too!
rows.notes: "Onii-chan": Ozma or Brera, left as "big brother"; the speaker is Ranka explaining support characters.

rows.en: Huh? Oh, I'll support Alto too!
Press up on the D-pad while locking on to switch the lock to an enemy ace or the two downed units.
rows.notes: "Both units" (ryouki) of the downed allies; same reading as in she_884.

rows.en: Press the Circle, Triangle, Square and Cross buttons together to purge your option parts.
Be sure to check the controls that have changed from before!
The last explanation is about the Anti-Missile Action.
Sheryl, it's thanks to you that I could explain. Sheryl gave me strength. So let's explain once more, Sheryl.
rows.notes: Odd gag line; read as a parody of Sheryl's catchphrase (see rnk_885/886), taken as heard. Possibly partly garbled.

rows.en: Listen to our...
rows.notes: Continues in rnk_886 ("explanation!"); parody of "Listen to my song!".

rows.en: ...explanation!
Press the Cross and Square buttons together to shoot down enemy missiles. This is the Anti-Missile Action.
A yellow missile marker is an enemy missile outside the Anti-Missile Action's range.
Shooting them down works in Battroid and GERWALK modes.
That's the explanation of the Anti-Missile Action.
Press the L and Triangle buttons together to level your aircraft.
I absolutely hate it when I can do something and don't.
I'm telling you I'll support you. Be grateful.
I can manage a little support. I'm Sheryl, after all.
If a pilot's job is fighting, my job is supporting.
Don't worry. I can do it. I'll show you.
Charge ahead at Macross speed!
Fly away!
Fate is something you seize with your own power.
I'll let you have the spotlight for a moment.
It's nothing. This much is nothing.
You've got guts, defying me.
Hmm, how interesting.
I won't be scared by a cheap threat like that.
This is nothing.
You do know what happens when you do this, don't you?
It's fine. I'm Sheryl Nome, after all.
My stage is just getting started!
There's no way I'd lose, not me!
I'm definitely going to survive!
I won't give up!
I'll fight even in despair.
No... me? Sheryl Nome...?
Is this as far as I go...?
No! My power isn't just this much! My power is...!
Worn out already?
Don't give up so easily.
Hey! Take this seriously!
How sloppy of you.
Looks like you need to be punished.
Answer me! If you don't, I won't forgive you!
Aren't you thoughtful.
Oh, are you a fan of mine?
Keep up the cheering like this.
Of course it'll succeed. Sheryl herself is backing you up.
rows.notes: Heard "Shiriru" for "Sheryl", the speaker's own name.

rows.en: For the record, it succeeded thanks to me.
That was quite a good stage. Not as good as mine, though.
I rarely give service like this, you know.
How dare you make me, Sheryl, go this far!
rows.notes: Heard "Shiriru" for "Sheryl", the speaker's own name.

rows.en: I'll charge ahead at Macross speed!
Fine, I get it.
Yes, yes.
I just have to do it, right?
Are you really the captain?
Pull yourself together. You're the captain, aren't you?
rows.notes: Heard "taishou" (target); read as "taichou" (captain) per neighbouring clips.

rows.en: What an unreliable captain.
I never thought the captain would be shot down.
A captain getting shot down is pathetic.
Don't you dare be dead! Captain!
Not bad! I'll give you some praise!
You're the captain. This much is only natural.
Pretty good effort, for Alto.
Listen to my song!
Here I go! Everyone, listen to my song!
All there is now is music, and me. Listen to my song!
Don't give me that leering look, pervert.
Quiet! I just thought of a good phrase!
Sorry, weak men aren't my type.
You tried hard, huh? I'll praise you.
You're my slave, so obeying me is only natural.
Well, as my slave, you pass.
Hurry back! My concert is about to start!
Be grateful. I supported you, no less.
Well? How was my stage from the best seat in the house?
Remember this. A woman this good is rare.
Don't get the wrong idea! It's the machine I'm worried about!
I almost never worry, so be grateful.
